lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A rectilinear arrangement of high-luminance circular spots organized into three primary horizontal rows. Centroids maintain consistent inter-blob spacing from the gill slits to the caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with longitudinal ridges; high-intensity spots are centered at these intersection points, creating a grid-like pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three parallel horizontal ridges run along the flank. Each ridge exhibits a distinct luminance gradient, with the dorsal edge showing higher intensity and the ventral edge showing lower intensity.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of high-luminance circular spots within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, with spots appearing primarily near the fin base and leading edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The cranial region displays a high-frequency distribution of significantly smaller high-luminance spots compared to the larger, grid-organized spots on the lateral flank.
